text:
Silver Price in 2020
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2020, the LBMA silver price rose 48.1% between 2020-01-31 ($17.89) and 2020-12-31 ($26.49). The highest sampled price was $27.35 in August and the lowest was $13.93 in March. The mean of these observations was $20.60. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2020:
COVID-19 and unprecedented monetary stimulus pushed gold above $2,000 per ounce for the first time.
